name: Crystal in a Slab
description: A semi-2D world: a 3D box as wide as a plate in x and y but only two particle diameters thick in z (boundaryDepth). A hot Lennard-Jones liquid cools into a bilayer: each layer orders into a triangular lattice and the two stack offset, as thin films of colloids do. Tilt the camera to see the layers; E shows or hides the box.
